newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 rises but market shaky ahead of poll.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 rises but market shaky ahead of poll.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index rounded off the week with its fifth straight gain after last weekend's first round senate elections gave a strong lead to the right.
The PX50 index rose 1.0 points to 510.1.
Dealers cautioned that the market was very nervous on Friday afternoon with foreigners still waiting on the sidelines ahead of the final round of voting which ends on Saturday afternoon.
"Today the market is shaky. It's like a snake. Five minutes up five minutes down. No-one knows where it is going," said Petr Koblic, a trader at Zivnostenska Banka.
SPT Telecom continued to outshine the rest of the major issues, posting a 42 crown gain to 3,014. SPT was the victim of heavy selling last week but has pulled back 9.4 percent since Monday's open.

Other highly capitalised shares performed less convincingly. Power utility CEZ, the second most heavily weighted share on the index lost 14 crowns to 940. Komercni Banka dropped 12 crowns to 2,095 and Ceska Sporitelna fell three crowns to 320.
Activity was moderate with turnover at 842 million crowns.
